v.why: Restoring the direct input-to-output residual path when it is missing yields far larger gains than swapping out an existing op on that edge.
Deleting the input-output skip removes the cell's residual shortcut, which hurts much more than deleting a conv or pool on that edge.
Any op on edge 3 helps a lot when the direct path is absent, whereas replacing a skip with a conv loses the residual benefit.
Adding a direct input-output path where none exists greatly improves gradient flow compared with replacing an existing edge-3 op.
Even a parameter-free path from input to output is valuable when the cell otherwise relies only on deep paths.
Without the direct input-output edge, removing edge 5 cuts one of the few remaining paths to the output and can collapse the cell.
When edge 3 is absent the output depends on paths through node 1, so cutting edge 0 is much more destructive.
Replacing a parameter-free pooling op with a learnable 3x3 conv adds much more capacity than replacing an existing conv or skip.
Swapping pooling for a 3x3 conv on an input edge adds substantial representational power in pooling-heavy cells.
When a residual skip already carries the input to the output, adding a conv on edge 5 gives little extra benefit compared with cells lacking that shortcut.

raw:
Ten hypotheses follow. Most of them rest on one pattern. Edge 3 (node 0 → node 3) is the only direct path from input to output. When it is `none`, the cell depends entirely on fragile deeper paths. When it is `skip_connect`, it gives a residual path that other edits mostly disturb.

- **What the data shows:**
  - Turning edge 3 from `none` into an op gave large gains on all three datasets (rows 61, 62, 91, 92).
  - Deleting a `skip_connect` on edge 3 was the most damaging edit observed (rows 12, 72, 82).
  - Edits made while edge 3 is already `skip_connect` were mostly neutral or harmful (rows 11–20, 71–80).
- **Pool → conv swaps:** replacing `avg_pool_3x3` with `nor_conv_3x3` on edges 0 and 1 gave unusually large gains (rows 46, 49). That suggests adding a learnable conv helps more when it replaces a pooling op.
- **Caveats:**
  - Hypothesis 10 (`avg_pool_3x3` on edge 3) was never directly tested. It is inferred from the general pattern.
  - Some contrasts rest on only one or two parent cells.
  - I did not run any new experiments to check these.
